references.text: The account of the Transfiguration, where some disciples see Jesus in his glory, which can be seen as a fulfillment of the promise in Matt 16:28.
Mark's version of the Transfiguration, paralleling the event described in Matt 16:28.
Luke's narrative of the Transfiguration, which can also be seen as a fulfillment of Jesus' words in Matt 16:28.
Jesus speaks about his return in glory, relating to his promise that some will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God come with power.
